about: Development rules for asymmetric car specs. Each team spends tokens on categories; each token changes the listed CarParams fields by the given fraction (value *= (1 + per_token)^tokens). Negative tokens trade a category down to free budget for others.

categories.label: Top speed
categories.about: Lower drag and a little more power: faster on the straights.

categories.label: Downforce
categories.about: More aero grip in fast corners, at some cost in drag.

categories.label: Handling
categories.about: Mechanical grip and a more agile chassis: slow corners and traction.

categories.label: Engine
categories.about: More torque everywhere, at a higher fuel burn.

categories.label: Tyre management
categories.about: Kinder suspension and cooling: tyres wear more slowly.

categories.label: Fuel efficiency
categories.about: Burns less fuel per lap: lighter cars or longer stints.

categories.label: Pit crew
categories.about: Faster stops: service time per token.
